newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Clinton is Ukrainians' best-loved politician - poll.
newsitem.headline: Clinton is Ukrainians' best-loved politician - poll.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton is Ukrainians' best-loved politician, according to an opinion poll published on Thursday.
The poll carried by UNIAN news agency showed Clinton, who is due to meet Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma in Washington on Friday, enjoyed the support of 69 percent of respondents.
Forty-one percent said they did not support Kuchma.
Half of those polled did not trust state authorities and the leadership of the former Soviet republic of 51 million people, while one-fifth said they were sure government officials were corrupt.
The poll of 1,600 people across Ukraine was conducted by the Ukrainian Foundation for the Free Economy and the U.S. Socis Gallop and GSL Research.
